powered_resistance.operator_after_disable: Clearly less resistant now, with robot still powered.
powered_resistance.interpretation: Resistance reportedly decreased after the non-enabling probe, which reinitializes SPI/IMU and sends an all-zero disable packet. This is consistent with a powered control-state contribution but is not an isolated damping-versus-flags experiment and does not establish firmware semantics, calibrated torque or mechanical health.
powered_resistance.source_finding: Neural controller deactivation retainskd0.1 damping. Hardware deactivate_motors clearsflags only; last command fields can remain. Init-only probe sends entirelyzero command includinggains.
